draft_en.subject: Alongside the Utepo PoE switches you stock - a budget managed-PoE position
draft_en.body:
Hi Scott,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "Marvell Industrial Alert System" on 14 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

Alongside the Utepo PoE switches you stock, neutral-brand units at distributor price, EXW, MOQ 1, 15-day validity, CE/RoHS/UKCA: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD; 24 x Gigabit PoE+ (280 W) + 4 x SFP, L2+ managed - STC-424DGGPM-280W - $134.5; DIN-rail industrial 8 x PoE+ + 2 x SFP, unmanaged - STI-288GP - $60. PoE accessories stay with your current source - we do not carry them.

One question: is there a budget managed-PoE position your installer customers ask for that the current range does not fill?

Best regards,
Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
